maddeler.e:
ارتقيا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَيَا (irtaqayā) /ir.ta.qa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# اُرْتُقِيَا (urtuqiyā) /ur.tu.qi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# اِرْتَقِيَا (irtaqiyā) /ir.ta.qi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
